title: Contain authenticated PR-comment 403 in canonical Required Gate Watchdog without losing later PR dispatch
root_cause: Post-merge live workflow #39811993147 job #119940435969 failed at GitHub POST /issues/4656/comments with 403 Resource not accessible by integration although issues:write was present. Uncaught exception aborted processing later PRs.
impact: One unauthorized failed-gate handoff aborts remaining watchdog work and leaves source recovery unrouted.
fix: Existing main already includes PR write authority (#4670) and bounded GET-only retries/PR exception isolation (#4679). This candidate adds max two handoff ATTEMPTS, catches denied comment within same-PR owner loop so missing Required dispatch continues, and preserves nonzero exit on any failed handoff; no duplicate schedule.
prevention_rule: Do not equate issue comment success with source repair; never let one 403 stop other safe dispatches; never mark refused comment green; preserve one scheduler, immutable head, original writer lease, security/CLS protections.
